bullets: Fixed the CLI landing screen to show a direct link to https://freebuff in the rate-limit message, and updated the model list to show Muse Spark 1.2 and metered Solar Pro 4.
Added an account-wide first-tab discount that gives a per-user Freebucks reduction on a single session, shared across Desktop and CLI, with a new detail chip and copy block in the model selector.
Changed the SDK's run() function to allow resuming a conversation on a different inference source when the new allowInferenceSourceChange option is set.
Improved Freebucks display so usage credits no longer show a peak price surcharge badge for Flash models, since Flash now uses a flat rate.
Fixed CLI session restart to rotate the chat id, so fresh conversations save to separate history directories instead of overwriting the previous one.
Added a YC matching promotion ready to grant a one-time $1,000 credit after collecting $1,000, with fixed limits and thresholds recorded for future use.
Added a separate Supabase agentic pilot format where eligible users see the same new assistant-style version instead of the ongoing random split test.
Improved the CLI to inspect sponsored-run capability before polling ads, with server-side preview and accept checks plus client-side containment probing.
Updated Freebucks reset and timezone copy to use the daily pool deadline and send an x-fb-timezone header on every session request.
Added client diagnostics reporting for sponsored delivery that normalizes browser, OS, and capability inspection facts into a diagnostic payload.
